simple.prompt: The developers ___ on this critical software bug for five consecutive hours.
simple.explanation: Subjek jamak 'The developers' berpasangan dengan 'have been' + verb-ing ('have been working') untuk aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih terus berlangsung.
hints: Rumus Present Perfect Continuous: have/has been + verb-ing.

simple.prompt: She is completely exhausted because she ___ non-stop since 7:00 a.m.
simple.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'She' berpasangan dengan 'has been driving' untuk aktivitas yang berlangsung terus-menerus dan dampaknya terlihat jelas saat ini.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Present Perfect Continuous dengan durasi 'all morning'.
simple.targetSentence: It has been raining all morning.
simple.explanation: Subject (It) + has been + Verb-ing (raining) + durasi waktu (all morning).

simple.prompt: How long ___ for the delayed commuter train?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan untuk durasi proses yang masih berlangsung hingga saat ini menggunakan 'How long have you been waiting...?'
hints: Menanyakan durasi aktivitas yang sedang berjalan.
Pola: How long have you been + verb-ing.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya Present Perfect Continuous.
simple.targetSentence: Have they been negotiating the contract all week?
simple.explanation: Have + Subject (they) + been + Verb-ing (negotiating) + the contract + all week?

simple.prompt: We ___ this new customer relationship software since last month.
simple.explanation: Kombinasi proses berkelanjutan dengan titik awal 'since last month' memakai 'have been using'.
hints: Aktivitas berlangsung sejak bulan lalu hingga sekarang.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat negatif Present Perfect Continuous.
simple.targetSentence: He has not been sleeping well lately.
simple.explanation: Subject (He) + has not been + Verb-ing (sleeping) + well + lately.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog penjelasan alasan kondisi fisik saat ini.
dialogue: Why are your clothes covered in white dust?
I apologize; I ___ the ceiling tiles in the storage room.
intermediate.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous digunakan ketika aktivitas baru saja berhenti dan bukti fisik dari proses tersebut terlihat sangat jelas saat ini ('covered in dust').
hints: Fokus pada aktivitas fisik yang menyisakan bukti nyata saat ini.

intermediate.prompt: Contrast: 'I ___ three chapters of the novel today' (Result/completion) vs 'I ___ the novel all afternoon' (Activity/duration).
intermediate.explanation: Ketika fokus pada hasil berapa banyak yang selesai (quantity/completion: 'three chapters'), gunakan Present Perfect Simple ('have read'). Ketika fokus pada durasi aktivitas ('all afternoon'), gunakan Present Perfect Continuous ('have been reading').
hints: Jumlah yang selesai $\rightarrow$ Present Perfect Simple.

intermediate.prompt: How many emails ___ since this morning?
intermediate.explanation: Pertanyaan yang menanyakan kuantitas 'How many / How much' (hasil pencapaian) selalu menggunakan Present Perfect Simple, BUKAN Continuous: 'How many emails have you sent?'.
hints: Menanyakan jumlah item yang sudah tuntas (How many).
Gunakan Present Perfect Simple, bukan Continuous.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat yang menyatakan kebiasaan baru temporer dengan 'recently'.
intermediate.targetSentence: She has been exercising at the gym regularly recently.
intermediate.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous sering digunakan untuk kebiasaan baru yang berlangsung akhir-akhir ini (recent temporary habits).

intermediate.prompt: Our analytics platform ___ steadily over the past few weeks.
intermediate.explanation: Proses perbaikan berkelanjutan yang berlangsung bertahap selama kurun waktu tertentu menggunakan 'has been improving'.
hints: Proses yang berlangsung bertahap dalam beberapa minggu terakhir.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya perbandingan hasil vs proses.
intermediate.targetSentence: How long have you been studying English?
intermediate.explanation: How long + have you been + Verb-ing (studying) + English?
hints: Awali dengan 'How long have you been'.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih bentuk yang tepat untuk aktivitas yang baru saja berakhir.
dialogue: Yes, I ___ up that steep hill.
intermediate.explanation: Kondisi terengah-engah (out of breath) adalah bukti fisik langsung dari proses lari yang baru saja berlangsung: 'have been running'.
hints: Menjelaskan penyebab fisik langsung saat ini.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kesalahan penggunaan stative verb dalam bentuk Present Perfect Continuous.
complex.draft: We have been knowing our senior business partner for over twenty years.
options: We have known our senior business partner for over twenty years.
We have been known our senior business partner for over twenty years.
We are knowing our senior business partner for over twenty years.
complex.explanation: Kata kerja stative (know, believe, understand, belong, own) TIDAK boleh berbentuk continuous (-ing). Gunakan Present Perfect Simple: 'We have known...'.
hints: 'Know' adalah kata kerja stative yang pantang memakai -ing.
Ubah menjadi Present Perfect Simple 'have known'.

complex.prompt: Notice the difference with permanent vs temporary residence: 'My family ___ in this ancestral home for centuries' (Permanent) vs 'I ___ with a friend until my apartment is ready' (Temporary).
complex.explanation: Keadaan yang dipandang sangat permanen (rumah leluhur berabad-abad) cenderung memakai Simple ('has lived'), sedangkan situasi sementara jangka pendek memakai Continuous ('have been staying').

complex.prompt: Someone ___ my artisanal coffee! There is only half a cup left! (Incomplete action / annoyance).
complex.explanation: Ketika aksi belum selesai (kopi masih tersisa separuh) dan si pembicara merasa jengkel, gunakan Present Perfect Continuous: 'has been drinking'. Sebaliknya 'has drunk' berarti kopi habis total diminum.
hints: Kopinya belum habis total (hanya diminum sebagian).

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat komparasi stative verb kepemilikan dengan 'have had'.
complex.targetSentence: We have had this server for five years.
complex.explanation: 'Have' bermakna kepemilikan (possession) adalah stative verb, sehingga memakai 'have had', bukan *have been having.
hints: Gunakan bentuk 'We have had this server'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penggunaan bentuk continuous pada kata kerja pencapaian yang tuntas seketika (achievement verbs).
complex.draft: The legal department has been finally winning the trademark dispute.
options: The legal department has finally won the trademark dispute.
The legal department is finally winning the trademark dispute.
The legal department was finally winning the trademark dispute.
complex.explanation: Kata kerja pencapaian seketika (achievement/punctual verbs seperti win, lose, find, stop, finish) tidak berdurasi panjang, sehingga tidak cocok memakai Present Perfect Continuous jika tuntas. Gunakan: 'has finally won'.
hints: 'Win' adalah peristiwa seketika (bukan proses panjang berdurasi).

complex.prompt: Throughout the ongoing corporate restructuring, the leadership team ___ transparent communication.
complex.explanation: Menekankan proses prioritas yang terus dikedepankan secara berkelanjutan sepanjang restrukturisasi: 'has been prioritizing'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog audit kinerja dengan pembedaan nuansa selesai vs berkelanjutan.
dialogue: Have you finished drafting the quarterly strategic forecast?
Not quite yet, but I ___ on it steadily all morning.
complex.explanation: Pekerjaan belum tuntas ('Not quite yet') dan prosesnya masih berjalan: 'have been working on it'.
hints: Pekerjaan belum tuntas dan masih berjalan.
